cd /workspace/dev && python3 - <<'EOF'
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev')
from harness import *
def A(body, pn=0, cid=b'\xaa\xbb'): return datagram(envelope('A',pn,body,cid=cid), auth=(0,))
# multi-byte local CIDs
r = run1([{'keys':['A']}, A(b'\x01',0), A(b'\x01',1,cid=b'\xcc\xdd'), A(b'\x01',2,cid=b'\xaa\xbc')],
         local_cids=('aabb','ccdd'))
print('wide cids', [(p['pn'],p['status']) for p in r['packets']], r['received'])
# retire sequence 1 then address it
r = run1([{'keys':['A']}, A(b'\x19'+v(1),0), A(b'\x01',1,cid=b'\xcc\xdd')], local_cids=('aabb','ccdd'))
print('retire wide', [(p['pn'],p['status']) for p in r['packets']], r['retired_local'])
# short header truncated with wide cid
r = run1([{'keys':['A']}, datagram(b'\x40\xaa', auth=(0,))], local_cids=('aabb','ccdd'))
print('trunc wide', [p['status'] for p in r['packets']])
# cid limit 4096 with many NCIDs
TOK=b'\x22'*16
body=b''
for i in range(1,50): body += b'\x18'+v(i)+v(0)+b'\x02'+bytes([0xe0+(i>>8),i&0xff])+TOK
r = run1([{'keys':['A']}, A(body,0)], cids=4096)
print('many ncids', [p['status'] for p in r['packets']], len(r['peer_cids']), r['retire_prior_to'])
r = run1([{'keys':['A']}, A(body,0)], cids=10)
print('over cap', [p['status'] for p in r['packets']], len(r['peer_cids']))
EOF
